summary.text: Valerie Moore is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 29 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she owns and manages Westby Meat and Grocery and serves on the House Taxation and Human Services committees.

paragraphs.text: Valerie Moore's career experience includes owning and managing Westby Meat and Grocery.
She served on the Westby School Board for 10 years and chaired the Westby Development Corporation for more than 20 years.
Moore won the House District 29 general election on November 5, 2024, and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Taxation and Human Services committees.
